# Proto-Gospel of James Chapter 20 — The EMET Bible (Literal)

**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** P.Bodmer V / Greek MSS, Proto-Gospel of James 20 | **Source Image:** source-texts/greek-EC/POX_020_page_001.jpg

---

## Chapter 20

**20:1** Now when Joseph was about to proceed into Judea, there was a great commotion in Bethlehem of Judea. For there came Magi saying, "Where is he who is born king of the Jews? For we saw his star in the east and have come to worship him."

**20:2** When Herod heard this he was troubled, and he sent officers to the Magi. And he summoned the chief priests and questioned them in his praetorium, saying, "What is written concerning the Christ? Where is he to be born?" They said to him, "In Bethlehem of Judea; for so it has been written." And he let them go.

**20:3** And he questioned the Magi, saying, "What sign have you seen concerning the king who has been born?" And the Magi said, "We saw a very great star shining among those stars and dimming them, so that the stars no longer shone, and we knew that a king was born for Israel. We have come to worship him."

**20:4** And Herod said, "Go and seek him, and if you find him, tell me, that I also may come and worship him."

**20:5** And the Magi went out. And behold, the star which they had seen in the east went before them until they came to the cave, and it stood over the cave. And the Magi saw the infant with his mother Mary and took out of their pouches gifts — gold, and frankincense, and myrrh.

**20:6** And having been warned by the angel not to go into Judea, they went away to their own country by another way.
